intro: Imagine ending your day with calm by your side. The Zyne bedside keeps your phone, book, and little treasures neatly placed, while its finish sets the mood for quiet, restorative nights.

features.title: A calming presence by your bed
features.text: Its clean design and soothing Sonoma Oak finish bring a grounded energy, making your nights feel less cluttered and more peaceful.

features.title: Space for the little things that matter
features.text: Perfect for resting your book, phone, or glasses close by, so you never need to leave the comfort of bed for essentials.

features.title: Design that blends
features.text: With seamless panels and concealed fittings, the table feels like part of your room rather than another bulky piece of furniture.

features.title: Everyday durability you can trust
features.text: Built from EN312, E2 grade prelaminated particle board, the structure is sturdy enough to handle years of daily use gracefully.

name: Zyne Engineered Wood Bedside Table
